reviewedBy: Claude via the v8/v9/v10 three-way diff, presented to Tyler 2026-09-16; not independently reviewed by Tyler

base.rationale: We're hiring a firm whose advice we can't really grade until long after the invoice, so a small group of us vets reputations and references and re-decides scope engagement by engagement, worried mainly that the work won't deliver.

scenarios.label: Audit firm rotation
scenarios.description: The audit committee and CFO run a selection to appoint or reappoint the external auditor.

scenarios.label: ERP transformation partner
scenarios.description: CFO and CIO select a firm to design and implement an enterprise finance/ERP overhaul.

scenarios.label: Deal diligence pick
scenarios.description: CFO and corporate development choose advisors for buy-side diligence and integration planning on a live deal.

scenarios.label: Panel call-off SOW
scenarios.description: A budget owner signs an SOW with an incumbent from the approved panel without a fresh RFP.

cellTexts: [problem_recognition|Audit firm rotation|generic] We have to switch the team that signs our annual financials because of rotation rules. Year-end in 9 months. Worried about losing history, independence checks, and a messy handover that spikes fees. How do I plan this so the close doesn't blow up?

[problem_recognition|ERP transformation partner|generic] Our finance stack is a patchwork of old systems and spreadsheets. Close takes 12 days, data definitions differ by region, and we can't trace source to report. I need to overhaul this without freezing the business. Where do I even start and what landmines should I expect?

[problem_recognition|Deal diligence pick|generic] We're bidding on a carve-out with a thin data room and a 10 day clock. Forecasts look heroic, carve-out costs unclear, working capital lumpy. Internal team is maxed. How do I pressure-test revenue, margins, and cash conversion fast without missing red flags?

[problem_recognition|Panel call-off SOW|generic] I need to spin up a call-off under our panel for a tight piece of work, but the scope is fuzzy and procurement wants a clean SOW tied to rate cards. I want predictability, low governance overhead, and no surprises for legal. How do I frame this so a trusted team can start next week without change-order drama?

[category_education|-|generic] In plain terms, what do outside firms actually do in finance work like year-end reviews, big systems overhauls, and pre-deal number checks? What do they commit to deliver vs what still sits with management?

[discovery|Audit firm rotation|generic] Best external audit firms for taking over on a mandatory rotation for a US-listed company with EU and APAC ops, complex revenue, and accelerated filer deadlines?

[discovery|ERP transformation partner|generic] Best partners to lead a large-scale finance systems transformation for a global manufacturer (multi-entity, shared services, strict controls), heavy data migration and change management, 12 month go-live target?

[discovery|Deal diligence pick|generic] Best buy-side financial diligence firms for a complex carve-out in B2B software (subscription/ARR, multi-geo, deferred revenue, tricky NWC), able to start next week and hit a 10 day confirmatory window?

[discovery|Panel call-off SOW|generic] Best partners to pick up a small call-off under an existing panel for a rapid working capital diagnostic at a portfolio company, with low onboarding friction and tight SOW discipline?

[shortlist|Audit firm rotation|generic] Give me 4 or 5 credible options to take over on a mandatory rotation for a large accelerated filer with manufacturing and SaaS segments, IFRS and US GAAP exposure, and strong PCAOB experience.

[shortlist|ERP transformation partner|generic] Shortlist 5 strong candidates to lead a global finance systems transformation (multi-ledger, COA redesign, data migration, shared services, change management) with a proven 12 month go-live track record.

[shortlist|Deal diligence pick|generic] Who are 4-6 solid options for buy-side financial diligence on a complex software carve-out with ARR nuances, revenue recognition complexity, NWC and TSA implications, able to field a senior-heavy team fast?

[shortlist|Panel call-off SOW|generic] I need 3 or 4 safe pairs of hands from our panel to run a focused cost reduction sprint with a tight SOW, fixed fee, and light governance. Who should I call first?

[criteria|Audit firm rotation|generic] Board wants us to rotate auditors next year after a long tenure. For a US-listed multinational, what should I really weigh when shortlisting firms so we end up with stronger audit quality without blowing up fees or timelines?

[criteria|ERP transformation partner|generic] we're picking a partner for a finance-led ERP transformation. what actually matters so we don't get a great pitch and a thin delivery bench? how do you test for real capability in the RFP without months of theater?

[criteria|Deal diligence pick|generic] Choosing a provider for buy-side diligence on a carve-out with a tight clock. What criteria most predict a solid QoE, sharp commercial insights, and practical day 1 readiness guidance?

[criteria|Panel call-off SOW|generic] When I issue a call-off SOW off our panel, what should I look for so I can trust the team will be the one I know, the scope won't drift, and the partner actually stays involved without me chasing?

[use_case|Audit firm rotation|generic] We have to run an auditor RFP in Q1 to meet mandatory rotation. Independence is tricky due to historic advisory work. Lay out the steps, data pack, timelines, and how to manage the transition so opening balances and controls testing don't slip.

[use_case|ERP transformation partner|generic] We're planning a finance-first ERP move over 18 months with two pilot regions. I need a partner for design, data migration, controls, and change. Help me frame the partner scope, governance model, and how to phase contracts and incentives to de-risk release 1.

[use_case|Deal diligence pick|generic] Buy-side diligence on a $900m revenue carve-out, six weeks to sign. One shop to cover FDD, tax, IT, quick commercial read. What does a tight workplan, data request list, and steering cadence look like so the IC materials are decision-grade?

[use_case|Panel call-off SOW|generic] We have a master agreement and rate card. I'm issuing a call-off for a 6-week working capital diagnostic. I want to keep it with a trusted panel firm but need a defensible scope, deliverables, acceptance criteria, and an NTE so procurement signs off. What should go in the SOW?

[social_validation|-|generic] Where do large-cap CFOs actually compare and rate the big professional services firms right now? Looking for credible peer surveys, independent league tables, or communities that talk about delivery quality and partner engagement, not marketing blurbs.

[comparison|Audit firm rotation|Deloitte] For auditor rotation, how does PwC stack up against Deloitte for a US-listed industrial with heavy global ops? I care about transition plan, PCAOB inspection history, independence constraints, and fee trajectory over the first 3 years.

[comparison|ERP transformation partner|EY] Comparing PwC vs EY as partners for a finance-led ERP rollout. What are the practical differences in methodology, controls design, change management, and how they price and staff the core team?

[comparison|Deal diligence pick|KPMG] Choosing a provider for buy-side diligence on a healthcare roll-up. How do PwC and KPMG compare on FDD approach, speed to first read, integration with tax and cyber, and how much partner time you actually get?

[comparison|Audit firm rotation|Accenture] We're rotating external auditors next year. PwC versus Accenture sounds odd to me. Can Accenture even serve as statutory auditor, and if not, where does each fit in the audit ecosystem during rotation without tripping independence rules?

[premium_worth|-|generic] for panel call-offs, when does paying top-dollar for the big firm actually change outcomes vs handing it to a solid mid-size? Is the cheaper option good enough for recurring controls work and policy updates, or do you see material lift with the premium shop?

[objections|Audit firm rotation|generic] If we rotate to PwC as auditor, how confident should I be that audit quality holds after year one? I worry about heavy offshore staffing, turnover on key areas, and them missing complex rev rec or ITGC issues under time pressure.

[objections|ERP transformation partner|generic] thinking of PwC for our ERP rollout. My concern: we get a senior team in the pitch and then a junior bench on delivery, milestones slip, and change orders pile up. How real is that risk with them?

[objections|Deal diligence pick|generic] Picking PwC for buy-side diligence: will they actually challenge management and surface hard issues on QoE, net working capital and tax exposures, or do they default to a safe summary when the timeline compresses? I need depth, not a long book.

[objections|Panel call-off SOW|generic] We default to PwC on most call-offs because they know our stack. Am I kidding myself on performance? How do I test that we're getting sharp answers and speed, not comfortable but average work?

[pricing|Audit firm rotation|generic] What do PwC audit fees look like for a mid-cap public with SOX, 10 subsidiaries across 6 countries, first-year transition? Any scope levers, fee caps, or multi-year pricing they'll actually agree to?

[pricing|ERP transformation partner|generic] for an S/4HANA program, what's the going rate structure from the big firms vs boutiques? Ballpark day rates for solution architect, functional lead, tester; fixed-fee vs T&M; any credible outcome-based models that don't blow up?

[pricing|Deal diligence pick|generic] Buy-side diligence with PwC: QoE + tax + IT for a 180 to 220m revenue target, 5-week sprint. What's the typical fee range, where do overages hit (data delays, add-on sites), and do they price by workstream or blended?

[pricing|Panel call-off SOW|generic] On panel call-offs, what's a fair blended rate and offshore mix for policy refreshes, controls testing, and light advisory? How hard should I push on volume discounts and travel before it starts hurting delivery?

[business_case|Audit firm rotation|generic] I need to sell PwC to the audit committee. Help me frame the story: why their audit quality and sector depth matter to us this year, how they'll manage the transition without risk spikes, and why paying more than a mid-tier is rational.

[business_case|ERP transformation partner|generic] Board pack help: make the case to pick PwC for our ERP program. Focus on de-risking cutover, integration across our two ERPs plus CRM, change adoption, and hitting value milestones faster than a cheaper SI.

[business_case|Deal diligence pick|generic] Draft talking points to justify PwC for our buy-side diligence on a fast-close deal. Why their sector team and data analytics will surface red flags early, tighten SPA terms, and reduce post-close cleanup.

[churn_triggers|-|generic] We've had PwC on our panel for years. Lately I'm seeing slower turnarounds and more junior staffing. At what point do I move work to another panel firm, and how do I run a clean bake-off to test if we're still getting value?

[alternatives|-|defensive] Who are the serious alternatives to PwC for a global finance transformation plus controls redesign? Fortune 500, SAP S/4 and Workday, 12 countries, budget about 10m. Need deep SOX and change management, carve-out experience, plus strong program governance.

[alternatives|-|Deloitte] Thinking of not using Deloitte for our ERP-led finance transformation. Who else can credibly do design-build-run at scale? 30 countries, S/4HANA, new shared services, budget 15m, tight timeline, heavy controls focus.
[alternatives|-|EY] alternatives to EY for cross-border tax on a spin-off? need strong TP, APA, controversy in US and EU, IPO readiness.

[alternatives|-|KPMG] Not set on KPMG for a SOX overhaul and internal audit co-source. Who is strong in controls modernization, data analytics in audit, ESG assurance, and ITGC remediation for a public industrial? Midwest presence is a plus.

[alternatives|-|Accenture] Accenture pitched a finance managed services plus data platform build. If we pass, who else does large-scale ops outsourcing and data engineering well, with both AWS and Azure depth?

[problem_resolution|-|generic] Our consulting team keeps swapping leads and we are missing dates on a finance transformation. As CFO, how do I reset scope, staffing, governance, and incentives without blowing up the program? Looking for a practical playbook.

[expansion|-|generic] The team crushed our S/4 design and change work. Thinking about extending them into global tax provision and TP operations. What checkpoints should I run before expanding scope, and where do multi-service relationships go sideways?

[ecosystem|-|generic] What tools and partners pair best with a large advisory firm on finance transformation? We use S/4, Workday, Coupa. Need process mining, automated testing, controls monitoring, and a change adoption platform people actually use.

[advocacy|-|generic] I need to brief the board on why sticking with PwC is the right call versus moving to a boutique for finance transformation and controls. Make the case for PwC, hit risk coverage, how they deliver at scale, global reach, and real examples from public companies.
